name: app-teal-gloved-hand-holding-pilgrimage-app
title: Silver Gloved Hand with Pilgrimage App
whatItIs: A cover on a dark teal gradient with a metallic silver gloved hand holding a phone showing an app with cream and brown cards and prayer times, and an Arabic-and-English logo at top right.
